title: 'Murder in Galicia' Comes to Netflix on 13 November
summary: From the creators of 'The Asunta Case' and 'A Widow's Game.'
body_markdown:
Entertainment


08 October 2026


Global


Spain


Link copied to clipboard


###


STARRING TRISTÁN ULLOA


[Watch the announcement video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zD47pUZxaZE)


[Download the first-look images](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/82731de5-d95c-46d0-acb0-11bace3fad1d)


Netflix has today revealed the release date, first-look images and teaser for its new miniseries


Murder in Galicia


, starring


Tristán Ulloa


(


The Asunta Case, A Widow’s Game, Berlin and the Lady with an Ermine


) and produced by


Bambú Producciones


. Based on a true crime story, the three-part series will premiere on Netflix on


13 November.


In the quiet village of Pazos, Aniceto (


Miguel


Borines


) and his wife Irene appear to be the perfect couple until one night, when she suffers a brutal attack during an apparent robbery. As she fights for her life in the hospital, Elías (


Tristán


Ulloa


), a sergeant in the Civil Guard who is convinced that Aniceto is the perpetrator, faces a system he perceives as unwilling to heed his warnings or protect the victim. With Aniceto free and Irene’s life hanging by a thread, will the truth come to light before it’s too late?


The cast also includes


Carlos Blanco


(


The Asunta Case


),


Fer Fraga


(


Band Together, Old Dog, New Tricks


) and


Miguel Borines


(


The Asunta Case


), among others, with special appearances by


Verónica Sánchez


(


Ángela, Sky Rojo


) and


Edu Soto


(


Campamento garra de oso


).


Murder in Galicia


is executive produced by


Ramón Campos


and directed by


Carlos Sedes


. The series is written by


Ramón Campos


,


David Orea Arribas


,


Curro Serrano


and


Gema R. Neira


, with


Carlos Garcés


serving as director of photography.


About Bambú Producciones


Bambú Producciones is a production company led by screenwriter and producer Ramón Campos. Since its founding in 2008, Bambú has established itself in international markets as a leading European production company thanks to titles such as


Grand Hotel


,


Velvet


,


Cocaine Coast


,


Cable Girls


and


The Asunta Case


. In addition to television series, Bambú also produces documentaries (


The Alcàsser Murders


,


The Asunta Case


,


800 Meters


) and feature films (


Malasaña 32


,


One Year, One Night


and


Band Together


).
